facts.fact: 开场黑色幽默：她觉得自己会死在婆婆开的车里。
facts.anchor: I was going to die in a car driven by my mother-in-law.

facts.fact: 她的资历表：面对过武装男人、杀人犯、Alpha。
facts.anchor: I had faced armed men. Murderers. Alphas.

facts.fact: 权力观：谁先到、谁等谁——开口之前权力已经定了。
facts.anchor: My mother had spent my entire life teaching me that power was established before anyone said a word.

facts.fact: 选择：她拉开 Mei Ling 旁边的椅子。
facts.anchor: I pulled out the chair beside Mei Ling.

facts.fact: Mei Ling 的公开表态：你女儿让我儿子更强。
facts.anchor: Your daughter has made my son stronger.

facts.fact: 她的清醒：我以为我是玩家，母亲仍当我是棋子。
facts.anchor: I'd thought I was finally a player. My mother still thought I was a piece.

facts.fact: 章末主题：这局也许不需要赢家，只需要新规则。
facts.anchor: Maybe this game didn't need a winner. It only needed new rules.
